dedupe_keys.name: timor leste petroleum interactive map anp wells fields psc contract areas 2d and 3d seismic surveys and airborne geophysics

description: Timor-Leste's national petroleum authority (ANP) publishes an interactive web map of its upstream petroleum data, built with QGIS and Leaflet, whose 109 layers load as GeoJSON files. Layer groups read on 2026-09-29: offshore boundaries, including the maritime boundary between Timor-Leste and Australia and the Kitan-Troubadour-Jahal development area; wells (name, land or offshore, kelly bushing elevation, surface coordinates, status such as gas or dry hole, maximum measured depth); oil and gas fields (gas and gas-condensate); onshore and offshore production sharing contract (PSC) areas; about 50 2D seismic surveys and 16 3D surveys (for example Bayu, Buffalo, Kyranis); airborne electromagnetic, gravity gradiometry (FTG), gravity and magnetic-radiometric survey lines over the mainland, Oecusse and Atauro. The wells layer was last modified on 16 July 2026. Coverage: national, onshore and offshore Timor-Leste. Format and access: web map, with layer files readable as GeoJSON; free. ANP also runs a virtual data room (EzDataRoom) for detailed exploration data, which needs a login. Licence: not stated. Caveats: layer names are survey codes with little attribute documentation. Simulation uses: exposure of offshore gas assets to earthquake and tsunami hazard, and capacity planning of gas supply. Related records: compare with the GEM Global Oil and Gas Extraction Tracker (data-gem-global-oil-and-gas-extraction-tracker).
